incident.name: Bybit Crypto Heist
incident.description: Lazarus Group compromised the Safe{Wallet} multisig interface used by Bybit, injecting malicious JavaScript to redirect a $1.5B ETH transfer. Largest crypto theft in history.
incident.root_cause: Supply chain compromise of third-party wallet UI, insufficient transaction verification
incident.lessons: Crypto platforms must verify transaction destinations out-of-band. Third-party UI dependencies are critical attack surfaces.

relatedIncidents.name: WannaCry Ransomware
relatedIncidents.description: Global ransomware attack exploiting NSA's EternalBlue SMB exploit. Hit 150+ countries, crippled UK NHS.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Patch management and network segmentation are non-negotiable.

relatedIncidents.name: Equifax Data Breach
relatedIncidents.description: Unpatched Apache Struts vulnerability exposed PII of 147M Americans including SSNs, DOBs, and credit card numbers.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Unpatched known vulnerability (2 months old), poor asset inventory
relatedIncidents.lessons: Patch management and asset inventory are foundational security controls.

relatedIncidents.name: Sony Pictures Hack
relatedIncidents.description: Destructive attack wiped Sony's network, leaked unreleased films, executive emails, and employee PII. Politically motivated.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Insider threat programs and data classification are critical for media companies.
